results.title: ACT Hockey: Dominant India storms into the final
Need for a unified urbanisation plan
results.content: The Union Budget, Economic Survey and Finance Commission recognise that India is urbanising across a rural-urban continuum. Yet Census 2027 will use the 2011 definitions, deepening the undercount of urban India; a National Urbanisation Policy can recognise this gap and build the institutional and fiscal mechanisms to bridge it

results.title: India secures $400-bn investment commitments in renewables; ALMM review in 15 days
results.content: Pralhad Joshi, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy told reporters that overseas investors have exuded confidence in India being a safe place for their investments.

results.title: Who filed 77% of Form 7s in Delhi’s Mustafabad? BJP BLAs named as ‘objectors’ deny them

U.S. midterm results may matter less for India-U.S. ties than for India’s room to manoeuvre in geopolitics
results.content: With U.S. President Donald Trump’s Republicans facing a major loss, the results could affect India’s position on the Iran war, Russian oil, the trade deal, immigration and China policy
